# crosswork_data_retention_network_performance (Resource)

This resource can manage the network performance data retention.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "crosswork_data_retention_network_performance" "example" {
  collect_lsp_state_change = false
  collect_lsp_path_change  = false
  collect_lsp_utilization  = false
  collect_lsp_pm           = true
  collect_link_pm          = true
  raw_hours                = 12
  hourly_days              = 5
  daily_days               = 20
  weekly_weeks             = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `collect_link_pm` (Boolean) Collect the link PM metrics
  - Default value: `false`
- `collect_lsp_path_change` (Boolean) Collect the LSP path change events
  - Default value: `true`
- `collect_lsp_pm` (Boolean) Collect the LSP PM metrics
  - Default value: `false`
- `collect_lsp_state_change` (Boolean) Collect the LSP state change events
  - Default value: `true`
- `collect_lsp_utilization` (Boolean) Collect the LSP utilization metrics
  - Default value: `true`
- `daily_days` (Number) Days that daily data is kept
  - Range: `1`-`31`
  - Default value: `31`
- `hourly_days` (Number) Days that hourly data is kept
  - Range: `1`-`7`
  - Default value: `7`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `raw_hours` (Number) Hours that raw data is kept
  - Range: `1`-`24`
  - Default value: `24`
- `weekly_weeks` (Number) Weeks that weekly data is kept. Each period must not be longer than the next
  - Range: `1`-`52`
  - Default value: `52`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the object

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import crosswork_data_retention_network_performance.example "data_retention_network_performance"
```
